description: One short row per AutoSEO article for a domain, newest first, without the article text: `id`, title, live `url`, status, the keyword or prompt it was written for, and when it changed: `publishedAt`, `lastSentAt` (the last time Cituna sent the page to the site), `editedAt` (the last edit to Cituna's copy) and `lastEnrichedAt` (the last refresh Cituna ran, whether or not it changed the page). `editsNotSent` is true when Cituna's copy was edited after the page was last sent. `hasDraft` is false for a page recorded with mark_article_published, which Cituna holds no text for. `outcome` is the page's own Search Console numbers from Cituna's last measurement, and `enrich.eligible` says whether enrich_article may refresh it. 50 rows a call: pass `nextCursor` as `before` for older ones, and `status` for one cut. get_article has one article's text. Free, reads stored data.

before.description: A previous call's `nextCursor`, for the next page of older articles.

status.description: Only these articles: live (published or sent to the site), review (waiting for approval), rejected, or attention (held by the publishing checks, or not delivered). Default all.

name: list_articles
